services.name: unWine'd and Dine
services.desc: Adult: $109 Youth (Ages 4-12): $99 About Unwinding is really what vacation is all about, so step aboard as we put a glass of wine in your hand and glide up river. Two thousand foot cliffs will surround you in the 1½ hour cruise. As you float back to our private dock you’ll enjoy live Western entertainment. Once you've returned, we’ll have a delicious dinner waiting for you. Total time for the jet boat and dinner is 2½ hours. Two drinks are included on the tour.
